text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Loves Only You...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Trainer-kun!
I found a Paka Puchi!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Trainer-chan!
I found a Paka Puchi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Loves Only You is pointing,
I see a crane game filled with plushies
themed after various Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~?
Don't you think that plushie is super photogenic?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"If I set this out while streaming,
it'd make the screen look super cute~."
choice_data_list: Then I'll get it for you!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure? Thank you.
You're so sweet, Trainer-kun♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure? Thank you.
You're so sweet, Trainer-chan♡"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I can't wait for today's stream♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
